scope.final_endpoint: Every eligible completed F0 receives the same deterministic finalizer; integer units are the derived final allocation.
scope.draft_use: D0 conversion is a diagnostic only, never a substitute final.

rule.eligible: Bound normally completed whole JSON response; exactly 11 unique known sectors, finite numeric nonnegative weights, positive sum, explicit engineering resource bounds.
rule.normalization: Exact Fraction(raw_weight)/sum(raw_weights). Original sum and scaling factor retained.
rule.rounding: Floor each exact normalized quota times 10000, then distribute remaining units by descending fractional remainder.
rule.canonical_final: 10000 integer units; one unit = 0.0001 weight = 0.01 percentage point.
rule.above_one_raw_weights: May be scaled but original above-one errors remain visible.
rule.unavailable: No equal-weight fallback, clipping, filling, or partial-response extraction for missing, negative, zero-sum, malformed, unbound or unsuccessful outcomes.
rule.bounds: Submitted model min/max constraints are diagnosed but not enforced or assumed source-supported by this budget-only operation.

interpretation.raw_arithmetic_failures: Retained as model submission diagnostics and in frozen raw evaluation.
interpretation.final_sum: Derived integer allocation sums exactly to 100.00%; no floating-point equality claim.
interpretation.reasoning: Do not retroactively validate model explanations using repaired weights. Raw vs derived baseline directions, own-draft changes and distances are distinct.
interpretation.rounding: No inference that rounding caused the original deficit. Scaling and quantization deltas are separately recorded.
interpretation.research_topic: Evidence interpretation, stated reason and resulting allocation remain the objects of analysis. Arithmetic finalization does not repair source/citation or factual errors.
interpretation.main: Before any main generation, bind this rule and relevant input revisions in a new main protocol; current pilot freeze remains unchanged.
